title: √2 is irrational
html:
1Suppose √2 = a ÷ b, a fraction in lowest terms
2Square both sides: 2 = a² ÷ b², so a² = 2b²
3a² is 2 × something, so a² is even — and so a is even: a = 2k
4Then 2b² = (2k)² = 4k², so b² = 2k²: b is even too
5Both even means both share the factor 2 — not lowest terms. Contradiction.
6So the supposition is false: √2 is irrational ∎

title: Resolving on a slope
about: Resolving|On a smooth slope at angle α
html: Weight mg acts straight down Resolve it: mg sin α along the slope, mg cos α into it R = mg cos α cancels the part into the slope What is left accelerates it: a = g sin α

title: Two masses, one string
html: Each mass feels its weight and the one tension T Resultant force = mass × acceleration, for each mass One string, one acceleration: 5 kg down, 3 kg up Add: 2g = 8a, so a = 2.45 m/s² and T = 36.75 N

title: Balancing moments
html: Moment = force × perpendicular distance from the pivot Slide the 20 N load out: its clockwise moment grows At 3 m: 20 × 3 = 30 × 2 — the moments balance
